01In summer 2025 we carried out an extensive service of a BC 12 domestic wastewater treatment plant that had been installed…

In summer 2025 we carried out an extensive service of a BC 12 domestic wastewater treatment plant that had been installed more than 20 years ago. The plant had suffered considerable damage as a result of the previous year's floods and was unable to operate properly.

Our service team carried out a complete clean, inspection and repair of the technology. After the necessary modifications and reconnection of the equipment, the plant was put back into full operation.

Thanks to this expert intervention, we extended the service life of the whole technology and restored its function so that it can continue to serve its users reliably.
